subject: Discovery recap: procurement & PO path for Helio Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + procurement questions (Helio Health)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks to help us map your vendor path: 

- Key decision criteria you flagged: latency under 200ms for demo flows, predictable per-token cost for forecasted 5M tokens/month, and an on-prem option for PHI-text indexing.
- Economic buyer you mentioned: Rajesh Patel (CFO) — can you confirm that Rajesh signs POs/commits?
- Procurement route: you indicated an intake form + procurement review then PO after SOW sign — can you confirm the procurement team contact and typical PO lead time?
- Security/legal: will you need a signed DPA + SOC2 in advance of pilot? Any internal questionnaire we should complete?

Next steps we propose:
1) Share a concise vendor-readiness packet (SOC2 summary, SOW draft, procurement roles sheet) — attaching Helio-Procurement-Roles.xlsx for your confirmation.
2) Intro to procurement and the person who issues POs (if different than the intake contact).
3) Schedule a short sync to align timelines (15–30m).

Attachments: Helio-Procurement-Roles.xlsx (xlsx) — utility sheet we filled based on today’s notes.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Samantha Green <samantha@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + procurement questions (Helio Health)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from my side (so you have the right contacts and expectations):

- Economic buyer: confirmed — Rajesh Patel (rajesh.patel@heliohealth.com), CFO. He typically signs POs above $50k.
- Procurement intake: send the vendor packet to procurement@heliohealth.com. Liam Park (Liam Park <liam.park@heliohealth.com>) is our procurement lead and will own vendor onboarding.
- Typical timeline: procurement intake review ~1–2 weeks, legal review (if SOW modifications) 1–3 weeks, PO issuance after SOW sign is usually 2–4 weeks depending on fiscal approvals. End-to-end vendor onboarding for new vendors is typically 6–8 weeks.
- Security requirements: we require a completed vendor questionnaire (attached) and either a SOC2 report or an attestation summary. We accept SOC2 Type II or a recent SOC2 summary PDF.

I attached the Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx we use. Please complete and return to procurement@heliohealth.com. I'll intro Liam on a separate email later today.

Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + procurement questions (Helio Health)

Hi Samantha and Liam —

Appreciate the fast response and the intake form. Liam — great to meet you, and welcome.

To keep momentum, proposed actions from Redwood:
- We’ll complete and return your Vendor-Intake-Form by EOD Monday (May 10).
- I’ll attach a short SOC2 summary and an initial SOW draft for a pilot (see attachments).
- Proposed joint sync with Procurement + Security + our Solutions lead: Tue May 11, 2027 10:00 AM PT — does that work for you? I can send a calendar invite.

Ben — can you prepare a one-page pricing note keyed to a 3-month pilot (expected ~500k tokens/month) and assumptions we discussed? Marissa — legal/SOW edits please stand by; I’ll route the draft once Ben and I finalize pricing.

If that schedule looks good I’ll send the invite and copy Rajesh for PO-level awareness.

Thanks,
Karthik

Subject: RE: Discovery recap + procurement questions (Helio Health)

Karthik/Ben —

Quick internal note before we send anything: I reviewed Helio’s intake form and flagged two items for Legal/Security:
- They request a hosted/on-prem architecture diagram — we should include a short ops note about PHI handling and isolation options.
- SOC2: we’ll send the SOC2-Summary.pdf (redacted where needed) and offer a follow-up audit call if they want more detail.

Ben, please draft the one-pager pricing and assumptions. I’ll review the SOW-draft.docx for any terms they commonly redline (data residency, indemnity caps).

I’ll also prepare the vendor packet and confirm we can return the completed Vendor-Intake-Form to procurement@heliohealth.com by EOD Monday (May 10).

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
